about.en: UP is the token of Unitas, a DeFi protocol that issues USDu, a yield-bearing synthetic dollar backed by market-neutral strategies. It is issued at 0x00007Ac313f4f4C1AD809E8A4Ca42bc613AA0000 on Ethereum, 0x000008D2175F9AEAdDb2430c26f8A6f73c5A0000 on BNB Chain and on Solana; it is unrelated to Superform's UP token, and some venues list it as UNITAS.
